title: Emergence
hook: Nobody designed your company culture. It just showed up from how everyone works together.
statement: Your system creates outcomes you never directly designed.
explainer: Culture, reputation, momentum. They come from how the parts interact, not from any single part. Great individual pieces can still add up to something mediocre.
sop: Pick 2 or 3 key interactions, like team and customers or product and marketing.
Score the strength of each Interaction 1 to 10.
Notice what pattern those interactions are creating right now.
Change how the parts interact, not the parts themselves.
Give it time. Emergent stuff shifts slowly.
equation_example: Team-to-Customers 7, Product-to-Marketing 8, Culture-to-Process 6. 7 + 8 + 6 = 21. That combined number drives things like culture and momentum. Higher means the parts make something bigger together. Lower means good parts that aren't clicking.
question: Write down one result in your business that nobody planned, and which interaction caused it.
closing_statement: The whole acts differently than any single part.
caption:
